plan.notes: Source: 'BA Modern Languages: English - Suggested Plan of Study 2025-2026 Catalog' (Dempsey College of Liberal and Performing Arts, Department of Modern Languages), official 2025-2026 SAU Undergraduate Catalog. Choice slots use the first-listed option's code with choice=true. Credit alignment note: the plan's Fall Semester 3 extraction shows the Physical Science row as 3 credits and the World Literature row as 4, but CHEM 1133/1131 is a 4-credit lab course and World Literature is 3 credits; sequenced as Physical Science 4 / World Literature 3 (semester total 16 either way). The Fall Semester 7 slot prints 'ENGL 4053 Comparative English Grammar or ENGL 4063 Introduction to Linguistics or TESOL' with an ambiguous trailing 'TESOL' - kept verbatim with code ENGL 4053.
